topics.title: Idioms & compounds from nature
topics.titleEs: Modismos y compuestos de la naturaleza
topics.intro_es: El inglés culto está lleno de imágenes de la naturaleza: plantas, mar, hielo y tierra. Úsalas con precisión en ensayos y debates sobre el medio ambiente (unidad «The natural world»).
topics.tip_es: Los adjetivos compuestos con guion (far-reaching, man-made, deep-rooted) solo llevan guion delante del sustantivo: a far-reaching reform, pero the reform is far reaching también se acepta.

items.ex: The reported cases are just the tip of the iceberg.
items.def: a small, visible part of a much larger problem

items.ex: The donation was welcome, but a drop in the ocean.
items.def: an amount too small to make a difference

items.ex: Teachers should nip bullying in the bud.
items.def: stop a problem at an early stage

items.ex: Years of conservation work are finally bearing fruit.
items.def: produce good results

items.ex: With rewilding on this scale, we are in uncharted waters.
items.def: a new situation with no previous experience

items.ex: There has been a sea change in attitudes to plastic.
items.def: a profound transformation

items.ex: Ministers who ignore the data are on thin ice.
items.def: be in a risky situation

items.ex: The green party won a landslide victory in the city.
items.def: a win by a huge margin

items.ex: Her ideas were a breath of fresh air in a tired debate.
items.def: something new and refreshing

items.en: make hay while the sun shines
items.ex: Tourism is booming, so the town is making hay while the sun shines.
items.def: take advantage of good conditions while they last
items.form: making hay while the sun shines

items.ex: The new law will have far-reaching consequences for farmers.
items.def: affecting many people or things

items.es: artificial, causado por el ser humano
items.ex: Most scientists agree that climate change is largely man-made.
items.def: made or caused by people

items.ex: Deep-rooted habits are the hardest to change.
items.def: firmly established and hard to change

items.ex: The fisherman had a weather-beaten face.
items.def: damaged or marked by the weather

items.ex: Choosing a simple life goes against the grain of consumer culture.
items.def: be contrary to what is normal or expected

items.ex: The cooperative branched out into eco-tourism.
items.def: start doing something new

topics.title: Identity & belonging
topics.intro_es: Las palabras para hablar de raíces, desarraigo y pertenencia a varias culturas (unidad «Identity and belonging»). Las banderas y mapas sirven de símbolo para cada idea.
topics.tip_es: Melting pot (las culturas se funden) frente a mosaic o salad bowl (conviven sin mezclarse): dos modelos opuestos de integración.

items.ex: Sport gives many teenagers a sense of belonging.
items.def: the feeling of being accepted as part of a group

items.ex: Moving every two years left her feeling rootless.
items.def: without a place you feel connected to

items.ex: The conflict caused the displacement of millions of people.
items.def: being forced to leave your home

items.ex: He never stopped longing for his homeland.
items.def: the country where you were born, with emotional weight

items.ex: She traced her ancestry back to a village in Spain.
items.def: your family origins

items.ex: Migrants often feel a kinship with others who have left home.
items.def: a close connection between people

items.ex: Athletes with two passports must choose their allegiance.
items.def: loyalty to a country, group or cause

items.es: vivir a caballo entre dos culturas
items.ex: Second-generation migrants often straddle two cultures.
items.def: belong to two cultures at the same time

items.ex: He was torn between his parents’ traditions and his friends’ lifestyle.
items.def: find it hard to choose between two things

items.ex: Terms like “Colombian-American” describe a hyphenated identity.
items.def: an identity that combines two origins

items.ex: New York has long been described as a melting pot.
items.def: a place where cultures mix into one

items.ex: Canada prefers the image of a cultural mosaic.
items.def: cultures that coexist without losing their identity

items.ex: Her cosmopolitan upbringing made her feel at home anywhere.
items.def: open to and shaped by many cultures

items.ex: The debate was criticised as narrow and parochial.
items.def: only interested in local matters

items.ex: Small island communities can become insular.
items.def: not interested in other cultures or ideas

items.ex: Many young people are reclaiming their roots by learning indigenous languages.
items.def: reconnect with your origins

topics.title: Arts & criticism
topics.intro_es: El lenguaje evaluativo de reseñas de cine, literatura y arte (unidad «Arts, culture and criticism»): elogiar, matizar y destrozar con elegancia.
topics.tip_es: Matiza con adverbios de grado: utterly compelling, mildly amusing, somewhat derivative, deeply poignant. Con adjetivos extremos (masterful) usa utterly / truly, no very.

items.ex: Her performance as the old queen is a tour de force.
items.def: an extremely impressive achievement

items.ex: The director’s masterful use of silence builds tension.
items.def: showing great skill

items.ex: It is a seminal novel that shaped Latin American literature.
items.def: very influential on later work

items.ex: The film ends with a poignant scene at the airport.
items.def: causing a sharp feeling of sadness

items.ex: The photographs are evocative of a lost Bogotá.
items.def: bringing strong images or memories to mind

items.ex: Her paintings carry a subversive message about power.
items.def: challenging established ideas

items.ex: The play opened to rave reviews.
items.def: extremely positive reviews

items.ex: The critically acclaimed series won six awards.
items.def: praised by critics

items.ex: Critics panned the sequel as lazy and predictable.
items.def: criticise very severely

items.ex: The orchestra gave a lacklustre performance.
items.def: lacking energy or brilliance

items.ex: Some viewers found the long silences pretentious.
items.def: trying to seem more important or clever than it is

items.ex: The overwrought dialogue spoils an otherwise good story.
items.def: too elaborate or emotional

items.ex: The album is pleasant but derivative.
items.def: copying the style of others

items.ex: The hotel lobby was full of kitsch souvenirs.
items.def: tasteless art or objects, sometimes enjoyed ironically

items.ex: The festival mixes highbrow theatre with street performance.
items.def: intellectual, for educated tastes

items.ex: Few comedies stand the test of time.
items.def: remain good or popular for a long time
